topline.note: Session 179-180 shipped the AI discovery spine and header discovery. Session 181 should make that machine-readable posture visible on the public status surface and reduce recurring task-board noise that keeps founder attention pointed at duplicated or stale human-action rows.

founderEvidence: Startup S181 surfaced a clean build posture but still showed skill-manifest drift and repeated human-action/task-board noise. Code read showed /status/ already renders generated proof tiles from api/*.json, while the AI spine is currently only checked by a build gate and not surfaced as a public-safe health artifact. TASK_BOARD.md also contains duplicate Human Action Required sections and stale older Now sections, making the founder-facing runway harder to scan despite the current work being evidence-gated.

items.summary: The AI-discovery spine is structurally correct, but only the build system can see that. A public-safe health artifact lets visitors, agents, and the status page verify that agents.json, llms.txt, shards, sitemap, and header discovery are alive together.
items.why: Info-finding outcome: an agentic crawler or technically-minded visitor can see that the studio's machine-readable discovery surface is current and internally consistent without reverse-engineering the build gate. Conversion outcome: the status page proves operational discipline instead of asking people to trust a hidden check.
items.recipe: Add scripts/build-ai-discovery-health.mjs that reuses the AI-spine validators to write api/ai-discovery-health.json with public-safe counts and status. Wire it into npm run build and build:check, add a /status/ live-signals tile, and include self-test coverage for healthy and broken spine cases.

items.summary: The task board is compacted, but duplicate Human Action Required sections and stale runway headings still leak into startup attention. That burns review time and makes real founder-gated decisions look noisier than they are.
items.why: Info-finding outcome: the next agent sees one current runway and one clear founder-action block instead of reconciling repeated sections by hand. Token-cost outcome: startup and audit reads spend fewer tokens parsing stale board surface, and the existing stale-open-task gate grows into a fuller runway hygiene guard.
items.recipe: Extend scripts/check-stale-open-tasks.mjs with a runway hygiene check that flags multiple Human Action Required headings and multiple open Now runway sections unless explicitly archived. Fix the current board into one S181 runway and one founder-action block, then keep the gate in build:check.
